rejection_summary.title: Revenger
rejection_summary.reason: A whole-film AsianMovieWeb review reports a prolonged action-light opening, with fighting only accelerating around the 30-minute mark and further lengthy pauses. Its attractive choreography alone is insufficient evidence of sustained action density, so it is not advanced as a candidate.

rejection_summary.title: One Percenter
rejection_summary.reason: Rotten Tomatoes review excerpts describe an extended setup that takes too long to begin and repetitive action beats. Whole-runtime density remains insufficiently established for a confident candidate despite the action-star-versus-yakuza premise.
